decision: Offline retrieval evaluation framework for CRA2 pilot

evidence.claim: Official docs expose ID-based context precision and recall without a judge.
Official GroundTruthAgreement API exposes precision_at_k and recall_at_k.

Same six ID fixtures, socket/DNS egress denied. Both had zero observed network/provider attempts; perfect=1/1, partial=.5/.5, miss=0/0, empty retrieval=undefined/0, duplicate=1/.5. Empty reference differs: Ragas=0/undefined, TruLens=undefined/undefined. Adapter must reject absent references and duplicate IDs; empty retrieval must fail, not be counted as a successful zero. No quality winner on valid cases.

Installed Ragas 0.4.4 emits a deprecation warning that both legacy ID metrics will be removed in v1.0 and have no direct collections equivalent. TruLens tested methods emitted no deprecation warning, but constructing GroundTruthAgreement without a provider defaults to an OpenAI integration; our successful offline trial supplied a forbidden provider. These are current integration constraints, not predictions of future releases.

Fresh locked uv trial environments on the same Python 3.13 host contained 92 distributions for ragas and 48 for trulens-feedback. Counts are not a vulnerability, latency or deployment-size benchmark. Both remain outside the app environment.

flip_conditions: Reevaluate if the selected framework fails the same frozen corpus/negative-control gate, attempts egress, or breaks its locked Python environment.
Reevaluate when Ragas supplies a maintained ID-metric API, or TruLens requires external services for these metrics.
Reevaluate with a blinded human-labeled answer set before selecting a semantic judge or production tracing backend.
limitations: Six synthetic ID-equality fixtures are API/correctness checks, not human-labeled semantic evaluation.
No measured answer faithfulness, jailbreak robustness, production cost, throughput, or end-to-end corpus comparison.
No superiority claim may be based on capability evidence alone.

options.integration: GroundTruthAgreement precision_at_k/recall_at_k with a forbidden offline LLMProvider to avoid the default OpenAI provider

requirements.text: "for evals, let’s try to use Ragas or ... TruLens"
Use only synthetic evaluation records locally/in CI; no external judge credentials or network calls in this pilot. Existing application is local evidence only.
Keep framework dependencies in an isolated Python 3.13 evaluation environment, outside the Cloud Run image.
Relative semantic judge agreement and future production tracing requirements have not been evaluated. Neither is needed for this retrieval-ID pilot.

smallest_separating_test: Run both adapters on the same frozen six-query CRA2 corpus set; require identical ID-score semantics, no egress and correct empty/malformed-score failures. If tied, no retrieval-quality winner is established.
